title: The Criminals of Kathmandu
subtitle: Secrets Lurk in Kathmandu’s Shadows
summary: When Feluda, his cousin, and the ever-imaginative Lalmohan Babu set out for an ordinary day in Calcutta’s bustling New Market, they stumble into a web of intrigue that reaches all the way to Kathmandu. What begins with casual conversation and ghostly tales soon spirals into a real-life mystery, as danger and deception follow their every move. Dive into this thrilling adventure where every alley hides a secret and every clue could be a matter of life or death.
